# Quick Installation Guide
## AX3000 Dual-Band Wi-Fi 6 Router Arcwave RT-AX58

### Package Contents
1. Wireless router
2. Power adapter
3. Network cable (RJ-45)
4. Quick Start Guide

### Hardware Overview

| No. | Item | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Power LED | Off: No power. On: Device is ready. Flashing slow: Rescue mode |
| 2 | WAN (Internet) LED | Red: No IP or no physical connection. On: Has physical connection to WAN |
| 3 | LAN 1~4 LED | Off: No power or no physical connection. On: Has physical connection to a LAN |
| 4 | WAN port | Connect your optical modem to this port with a network cable |
| 5 | LAN 1~4 ports | Connect your PC to a LAN port with a network cable |
| 6 | Power (DC-IN) port | Insert the AC adapter into this port |

### Setting up your router

1. Unplug the power cable from your modem.
2. Connect the modem to the router's WAN port with the supplied network cable.
3. Power on the modem and the router.
4. Connect your PC to the router with a network cable or via Wi-Fi (the SSID is printed on the label).
5. Open a web browser. You will be redirected to the setup wizard. If not, go to http://router.arcwave.net or 192.168.50.1.
6. Alternatively, download the Arcwave Router app and scan the QR code on the label.

You will need a computer or smartphone to complete the setup.

### Specifications

| Network Standard | IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax |
| WAN connection | Automatic IP, Static IP, PPPoE, PPTP, L2TP |
| Dimensions | 290 x 160 x 65 mm |
| Power supply | 12 V / 1.5 A |
